verdict.rationale: Shared payment tokens carry documented usage limits (currency, max_amount, expires_at) and can be revoked at any time so sellers can't charge them. Link CLI adds human approval of every spend request with one-time-use credentials, and restricted API keys limit what an agent can do in an account. These are per-token and per-request controls, not a user-facing per-agent budget, and the SPT limits are set by the issuing agent rather than the end user. Missing for 10: per-agent aggregate spend caps or budgets configurable by the user, a documented way to revoke all of an agent's payment authority at once (beyond individual SPTs or keys), and independent or hands-on corroboration that revocation is instant.
